_what: What each codeline IS and what an agent working inside it needs to know that the source does not say. Produced by the codeline-discovery agent during THIS run and rewritten every run — never accumulated, so nothing here is older than the run that wrote it. The engine splits this per codeline into each worktree's .epam/.
_shape: Codeline names are TOP-LEVEL keys, because the engine extracts one with jq '.[$cl]'. Nesting them under another key parses fine and yields nothing for every codeline.

facts.text: Tests run via `jest`, and `pretest` runs `npm run build:config` (esbuild bundling `next.config.source.ts` to `next.config.js`) before tests execute — this build step must succeed or `npm test` fails before any test runs.
A pre-commit hook enforces a strict branch-naming pattern and will reject the commit if the current branch doesn't match `^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(/[a-z0-9-]+)?$`.
Component-level tests for this exact page already exist at `src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/CheckoutForm.spec.tsx` and `Checkout.spec.tsx`, so the fix's regression coverage belongs there.
